title: The Missing Number

statement.markdown:
`nums` contains `n` **distinct** integers drawn from the range `0..n` (inclusive) — so exactly one number from that range is absent. Return it.

There's a well-known O(1)-space trick. Can you find it?
constraints: All values are distinct and within 0..n

tests.note: missing the top of the range

hints: If nothing were missing, what would the sum of 0..n be?
Sum of 0..n is n·(n+1)/2. Subtract the actual sum — the difference is the missing number.
solutionExplanation: The full range 0..n sums to n·(n+1)/2. Since exactly one value is missing, the difference between that ideal sum and the actual sum is the answer. Time O(n), space O(1). (XOR-ing indices against values works too.)
